card.name: Start of trial names after In
card.fires_on: The first letter piece of an all-caps clinical trial name right after the word In, as in 'In COLUMBUS' or 'In MARIPOSA'. It also fires on 'in' after 'observed' before 'some patients'.

modes.label: Trial name after In
modes.description: A capital letter starting a trial acronym after a sentence-opening 'In'.
modes.example: Cutaneous Malignancies In<< C>>OLUMBUS, cutaneous squamous cell

modes.label: in before some patients
modes.description: The word 'in' after 'have been observed' ahead of a group of patients.
modes.example: fluid retention and edema have been observed<< in>> some patients treated with NSAIDs.

card.writes: It promotes 'those' and similar words, suggesting a pointing word for a group that follows.
card.plain: It marks the start of a trial name after 'In', where the text goes on to report results in a group of patients.
